blurb: Crooked Goat Brewing operates two taprooms and breweries in Sebastopol and Petaluma, each with a variety of beers on tap and food options from local partners. They offer private event spaces for rent and host public events such as trivia, mixers, and live music. Their beer selection includes core and rotational beers with diverse styles and flavors.
